title: Section 700.10 – Revise Section 700.10(A)(2) to read as follows:
officialText:
(2) An acceptable means of marking shall include, but is not limited to, a permanently affixed identification nameplate,
yellow in color with black lettering. Accessible cable or raceway systems shall be marked at intervals not to exceed
10 ft (3 m) or identified by a continuous yellow outer finish along raceways entire length.
